title: 13 Hidden Signs Your Class Is Out Of Control
author: Michael Linsin
summary: Linsin argues that many teachers have an out-of-control class without realizing it, either because they have grown used to chaos or because they have never witnessed a genuinely well-behaved class for comparison. Drawing on his experience running Q&As, where he estimates at least 20 percent of questions reveal deeper systemic problems than any single strategy can fix, he presents 13 diagnostic signs -- ranging from needing to raise one's voice, redoing routines daily, and slow transitions, to students misbehaving behind the teacher's back and refusing to take responsibility. His central claim is that when several of these signs are present at once, the underlying problem is not any single fixable behavior but the entire approach, meaning piecemeal fixes are futile and the teacher needs a full restart. The concrete recommendation is to rebuild from the ground up using foundational First Days of School resources rather than searching for individual patches to individual symptoms.
